title: Self-Building Labs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. tldr: 该论文提出“自构建实验室”（SBL），能根据高层科学目标自主设计并搭建实验室的布局、数字孪生、机器人技能与实验流程，突破了现有自动驾驶实验室灵活性不足这一制约科学发现规模化的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Self-Building Laboratory (SBL), which autonomously designs, configures, and operates its own lab setup—including layout, digital twin, robot skills, and workflows—from a high-level scientific goal, overcoming the flexibility bottleneck that limits existing self-driving laboratories in scaling scientific discovery.
